_note: Thomas, 2026-09-05: 'finish this stuff up' — the leads left in _dropped by the ESMS pass and the price-index round. Household budget surveys for FR, IT, DK, CZ, NO; Luxembourg's national accounts and HBS; the Swiss and Albanian consumer price indexes. Every node's url is the statistics office's own page (or, for the Swiss FSO whose HTML pages are JavaScript shells, its own explainer PDF), read live from the sandbox and quoted; every weight-source edge quotes Eurostat's prc_hicp_esms*_<cc>.htm section 18.1.1 verbatim; eurostat-hicp edges quote transmission sentences (CH 18.5, LU 6.2). Albania's ESMS page has no transmission sentence — INSTAT's own HICP page says the index is 'calculated and published according to the Classification of the Individual consumption by purpose ECOICOP used by Eurostat', which is a classification, not a transmission, so no eurostat edge for AL.

reports.title: Enquête Budget de famille (BDF) — Household Budget Survey
reports.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques (INSEE)
reports.description: INSEE's household budget survey. Its source page: "L'enquête Budget de famille (BDF) vise à reconstituer toute la comptabilité des ménages : dépenses et ressources des ménages résidant en France (métropole et Dom)." and "toutes les dépenses des ménages sont enregistrées, leur montant et leur nature, ventilés dans une nomenclature d'environ 900 postes budgétaires (calquée en partie sur la COICOP". Eurostat's France HICP metadata records the 2017 wave as the one in use, the next collected through 2026.
reports.cadence_note: Roughly every five years (2006, 2011, 2017, next 2026 — Eurostat's France HICP metadata 18.1.1: 'The next HBS survey has started and will be conducted throughout the year 2026'). Recurring survey, not a one-off instrument.

reports.title: Spese per consumi delle famiglie — Household Budget Survey
reports.description: ISTAT's annual household consumption expenditure survey and release. The 2024 release: "Nel 2024 la stima della spesa media mensile delle famiglie residenti in Italia è di 2.755 euro in valori correnti, sostanzialmente invariata rispetto ai 2.738 euro del 2023 (+0,6%)." Eurostat's Italy HICP metadata uses it for about 140 of the ~400 product-aggregate weights below the sub-index level.
reports.cadence_note: Annual release ('Spese per consumi delle famiglie – Anno 2024', October 2025).

reports.title: Forbrugsundersøgelsen — Household Budget Survey
reports.description: Statistics Denmark's annual household budget survey. Its documentation: "Formålet med Forbrugsundersøgelsen er at belyse de private husstandes detaljerede privatforbrug samt de samlede økonomiske forhold. Statistikken anvendes blandt andet som vægtgrundlag til Forbrugerprisindekset og til beregning af det private forbrug i Nationalregnskabet. Statistikken blev første gang udarbejdet i 1897 og årligt siden 1994." — i.e. the documentation itself names the CPI and the national accounts as its users.
reports.cadence_note: Annual since 1994 ('årligt siden 1994'); published about 12 months after the reference year ('Statistikken udkommer ca. 12 måneder efter referenceårets udløb').

reports.title: Statistika rodinných účtů (SRÚ) — Household Budget Survey
reports.publisher: Český statistický úřad (ČSÚ) / Czech Statistical Office
reports.description: The Czech Statistical Office's household budget statistics (Statistika rodinných účtů), published under 'Příjmy, výdaje a životní podmínky domácností'. The topic page: "Potraviny a nealkoholické nápoje tvoří dlouhodobě spolu s výdaji za bydlení, vodu, energie a paliva největší část všech spotřebních výdajů českých domácností." Eurostat's Czechia HICP metadata names it as the main source of elementary-aggregate weights.
reports.cadence_note: Annual household expenditure statistics ('Spotřební výdaje domácností - data za rok 2024'), with quarterly products in the series.

reports.title: Forbruksundersøkelsen — Household Budget Survey
reports.description: Statistics Norway's survey of household consumption expenditure: "Statistikken gir et detaljert bilde av norske husholdningers årlige forbruk av ulike varer og tjenester. Videre gir den innsikt i hvordan forbruket varierer mellom ulike husholdninger og hvordan forbruksmønstre endrer seg over tid." Eurostat's Norway HICP metadata: the last HBS used for the CPI/HICP weights dates from 2012 and covers about 30 per cent of the basket at the lowest level.
reports.cadence_note: Irregular — SSB's page carries the 2012 survey as the latest ('Publisert 17. desember 2013'); Eurostat's Norway HICP metadata: 'Last updated HBS goes back to 2012'. Recurring survey, not a one-off instrument.

reports.title: Comptes nationaux — National Accounts (ESA 2010 / SEC 2010)
reports.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques (STATEC)
reports.description: Luxembourg's national accounts, compiled by STATEC. Its methodology description: "Les comptes nationaux luxembourgeois sont établis selon les normes et définitions du SEC 2010 (Système Européen des Comptes) qui est le cadre comptable de référence pour les pays de l’UE." and "Le SEC 2010 prescrit l’établissement de comptes agrégés, sectoriels et par branches (annuels et trimestriels)." Minted 2026-09-05 because the corpus had no Luxembourg national-accounts node for the IPCH weights to point at.
reports.cadence_note: Annual and quarterly accounts ('annuels et trimestriels'); releases_per_year follows the quarterly cadence as the other national-accounts nodes do.

reports.title: Enquête Budget des Ménages (EBM) — Household Budget Survey
reports.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques (STATEC)
reports.description: STATEC's household budget survey. Its methodology page: "Nearly every 5 years, Eurostat collects the national HBS data to harmonize ex-post and to create a european data basis on household budgets." Eurostat's Luxembourg HICP metadata (18.1.1) calls it 'the continuous Household Budget Survey' and 'the t-2 annual household budget survey (HBS), conducted by STATEC'.
reports.cadence_note: Continuous, annual results (Eurostat's Luxembourg HICP metadata: 'the yearly HBS'); Eurostat's ex-post harmonised collection is roughly every five years.

reports.title: Landesindex der Konsumentenpreise (LIK) / Indice suisse des prix à la consommation (IPC) — Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
reports.publisher: Bundesamt für Statistik (BFS) / Federal Statistical Office (FSO)
reports.description: The Swiss consumer price index, compiled monthly by the FSO, which also compiles a Swiss HICP for Eurostat. The FSO's own explainer: "Der Landesindex misst die Teuerung der Konsumgüter in der Schweiz. Der LIK zeigt, um wieviel die Konsumgüter teurer geworden sind gegenüber dem Vormonat, dem Vorjahr oder jedem anderen früheren Zeitpunkt." The FSO's HTML pages are JavaScript shells to a text fetcher, so the node cites the explainer PDF; Eurostat's Switzerland HICP metadata (8.3) says the HICP and national CPI are disseminated monthly on the FSO's website.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly (Eurostat's Switzerland HICP metadata 8.3: 'the HICP and National CPI figures are monthly disseminated').

reports.title: Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP), Albania
reports.description: INSTAT's monthly consumer price index and, since 2017, its harmonised index. INSTAT's HICP page: "In January 2017 INSTAT published for the first time the Harmonised indices of consumer prices" and "The HICP weights are constructed in accordance with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2016/79. The HICP weights reflect the structure of the FMCE (domestic concept)." Its CPI page: "Starting from February 2026, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) is calculated according to the ECOICOP 2018 classification."
reports.cadence_note: Monthly releases ('Consumer Price Index, May 2026' and the monthly HICP publications on INSTAT's site).
